findings.text: the reduction drops the repository-name prefix only when it equals the annotating process's own checkout directory (the constant is read from this module's location at :523), so a log spelled with another checkout's name, which is what an arm invoked from that checkout's parent prints, is compared unreduced; measured: added_failures_from_gate_logs over tests/x.py::test_gate against some-other-checkout/tests/x.py::test_gate returns (1, ['some-other-checkout/tests/x.py::test_gate']) in logs/probes.log, the phantom the reduction exists to remove, which caps a sound run's total whenever the reader, a review or a promotion, runs in a different checkout from the arm.

the case builds the spelling it asserts on from review_module._REPO_DIRECTORY_NAME, the same attribute canonical_node_id reads, so it passes for any value of that name including a misderived one; measured by running the case with the attribute set to a wrong name in-process, no file changed (logs/probes.log), which leaves the name's derivation unpinned while the reduction branch is pinned.
